description: Generate commit messages and split your changes into minimal commits with the Claude Code CLI, following each repository's own conventions (CLAUDE.md and commit history).
command.split: Split changes into commits with Claude
config.title: Commits with Claude Code
config.claudePath: Claude Code executable. With 'claude' it looks in ~/.local/bin first and then in the PATH.
config.messageModel: Model used to write the commit message (value for claude --model).
config.splitModel: Model used to split changes into commits (value for claude --model).
config.splitBy: How changes are cut before Claude groups them into commits.
config.splitBy.file: Each file goes whole into a single commit.
config.splitBy.hunk: Each hunk separately: one file can be spread over several commits.
config.confirm: What is asked before creating the commits. A warning from Claude (for example, a protected branch) is always confirmed.
config.confirm.confirm: One confirmation dialog with the list of commits.
config.confirm.review: First a list to uncheck commits and edit messages, then the confirmation dialog.
config.confirm.none: Create the commits straight away; the final notification offers Undo.
config.exclude: Paths (git pathspecs) that are never sent to Claude nor committed from here.
config.extraInstructions: Instructions appended to the prompt, on top of the repository's CLAUDE.md conventions.
config.timeoutSeconds: Maximum time to wait for claude -p, in seconds.
